title: Pinwheels (nut butter and jelly tortilla roll-ups)

text: Looks like you're making pinwheels. Want me to walk you through it?

detail.title: Pinwheels (nut butter and jelly tortilla roll-ups)

text: Take one 8-inch flour tortilla and lay it flat on the cutting board. Don't heat it, just use it as it is.
Pick up a butter knife, open the nut butter jar, and scoop out a good spoonful of nut butter on the blade.

detail.chip: Scoop nut butter with butter knife

text: Spread the nut butter in an even layer over the tortilla, but stop about half an inch before the edge all the way around.

mistake.description: Only a small patch is covered; tortilla left mostly bare
mistake.correction: Scoop a little more and spread it out until only the half-inch border is bare.

text: Wipe the nut butter off the butter knife with a paper towel so it's clean for the jelly.

view_request: Show me The knife and paper towel in hands

text: With the clean butter knife, scoop a dollop of jelly out of the jelly jar.
